status: draft until A/A: SESOI, n clumps/sessions and the live:non-beating ratio are set from 2 A/A sessions (REVIEW item 10, `session.py aa`), then sealed as design_v2
note: Design v1 for the nasal-cilia x weak DC field experiment (cilia/PROTOCOL.md). Structure fixed now; the smallest effect of interest and the number of sessions are fixed after the baseline phase, in design_v2.
field_set_by: measured: E = dV/L from sense electrodes in the wells; target current I = sigma*E*A (seawater ~5 S/m: about 250 uA for 1 V/cm in a 5 x 0.1 mm channel; pond water ~0.05 S/m: about 2.5 uA)
primary_outcome: SUPERSEDED by co_primary_outcomes (REVIEW SHOULD on primary outcomes); kept for the record: clump drift along the field axis, FWD minus REV, in live clumps minus the same contrast in dead (heat-killed) clumps from the same sample
secondary_outcomes: rotation FWD minus REV (live minus dead)
CBF FWD minus SHAM and REV minus SHAM (live)
analysis: SUPERSEDED by co_primary_outcomes/alpha_co_primary (two co-primaries at alpha 0.025 each); kept for the record: per clump paired changes from the preceding OFF epoch; live vs dead two-sample permutation on the primary; sign-flip tests for secondaries; two-sided alpha 0.05 primary, secondaries descriptive
temperature: logged at start and end of every clump; a clump whose temperature changes by more than 0.5 C is excluded (was 1.0 C)
hand_check: every tenth clip counted by hand for CBF; FFT readings that differ by more than 20% are replaced by the hand count and flagged
clump_types_note: non-beating = never heated, same drop as live clumps, classified by active_fraction (type_rule); heat-killed (50-55 C) is secondary. v1 had {live: 6, dead: 3}; ratio to be reset from A/A SDs.
epoch_structure: per clump: OFF(60 s), C1(30 s), OFF, C2, OFF, C3, OFF; conditions randomised per clump; SHAM is a time control (switch open)

trk.name: <session>_<clump:02d>_<epoch:02d>_trk.mov
trk.film: through the epoch until 10 s before its end

cbf.name: <session>_<clump:02d>_<epoch:02d>_cbf.mov
cbf.film: 5 s slow motion before the epoch ends

field_target.well_voltage: field_V_per_cm x sense_spacing_cm (2.2 V); E = dV/L from the sense electrodes

exclusions.lost_clump: epochs from the lost epoch onwards
exclusions.track: clump velocity dropped if the clump was tracked for under half the clip

type_rule.source: median active_fraction over the clump's OFF-epoch CBF clips

co_primary_outcomes: CBF field effect in live clumps: mean over FWD and REV of (CBF epoch - preceding OFF) minus the same for SHAM; sign-flip test across live clumps
tracer-corrected drift along x, (clump_vx - tracer_vx) change from preceding OFF, FWD minus REV, live minus non-beating clumps; within-session label permutation
secondary_outcomes_v2: |rotation| field (FWD,REV) vs SHAM in live clumps
per-session summaries; session means as the unit (one donor)
tissue: mussel gill (fish-market blue mussel, Mytilus) in filtered mussel liquor or artificial seawater; Paramecium (hay infusion) as the rig positive control. Human cells: out of scope for home work (clinician collection only).
sesoi_rule: CBF: max(2 x SD of the A/A CBF contrast, 15% of CBF). Drift: 2 x SD of the non-beating clump FWD-minus-REV drift contrast from the A/A sessions (planner decision: the tracer-based SD collapses to ~0 when the fluid is still).
